description: MCP protocol version matrix. 0.3.0 target = legacy negotiation between 2024-11-05 / 2025-06-18 / 2025-11-25 (the server echoes a supported requested version and rejects unknown ones instead of silently downgrading). Modern 2026-07-28 (stateless, per-request _meta, server/discover) is explicitly 0.3.1+, not part of this contract.
negotiationNote: Implemented in 0.3.0 (lib/mcp-server.js): initialize echoes a requested version when it is in supportedProtocolVersions, and a missing or unknown version (including the modern 2026-07-28 stateless revision, which needs server/discover) falls back to defaultProtocolVersion 2024-11-05 so pre-0.3 clients observe exactly the old behaviour. The 04/15 research target was a readable error listing the supported matrix; 0.3.0 deliberately chose the legacy-compatible fallback instead. The checker asserts both the echo and the fallback while negotiation is "active-fallback"; set negotiation to "active" only if the server is changed to reject unknown versions.

modernProtocol.note: Fallback target only: initialize with 2026-07-28 returns 2024-11-05 instead of an error (intentional legacy compatibility).
